name: vericomp-uniform-30k-scratch
description: Equal-quota (uniform) compression arm trained from scratch for 30k updates. Hyperparameters are copied from the 20260813/vericomp-128k run (24,414 updates, 4 GPUs, lr 3e-4, warmup 1000, wd 0.01, grad-clip 2.0, 98.5M params, 8 length buckets up to 131072). The only deliberate changes are total_updates 24414 -> 30000 and allocation_mode dynamic -> uniform, so the arm is a like-for-like control for the HelixPack (dynamic) arm rather than a continuation of it.

provenance.note: The reference run was itself the root of the residual-skip chain; it has no init_from, so it is the from-scratch baseline.

data.note: The historical run used /root/data/hg38/*; those files no longer exist. The gpfs_data copies are the same hg38 masked FASTA and BED.
